objective: Strongest validated deterministic student or small ensemble on measured quality versus competition CPU runtime frontier
authority: User-provided full plan plus follow-up: save all of it, continue theory and nonblocking research while user uploads CPU probes later

comparison.teacher_version: bind clean source-qualified cohort before admission
comparison.checkpoint_rule: fixed terminal update; exact budget frozen in first fit recipe before results

exposure: All existing folds exposed. Cross-fold robustness is not pristine confirmation. Separate component, training-seed, and transfer uncertainty.

compute.kaggle: fresh measured renewable quota; actual-device profiles before substantial fits

admission: Root binds exact source/data/command and measured resource bounds. No launch-and-see allocation. Healthy admitted jobs preserved; diagnosed failures get new attempt IDs.

stop.explicit_user_stop: close new admission and drain healthy jobs
stop.quota_exhaustion: collect artifacts and continue local/theory work
stop.uncertain_quality: allocate by information value; zero-crossing intervals are not universal kill gates

delivery: checked A/B/C/D CPU probes with reproducible native sources and assertions
paired official grades and cross-fold/seed frontier
